body:
As we all know, Sunny has hit level 100 overall recently, but now he has also got the awesome achievement of maxing out his rank on Nebula, being 15th prestige and level 50, or the equivalent to level 800. I just wanted to say that the update has only been out 44 days ( I think ) and you have already done 10 more prestiges, which I believe is 1 prestige every 4 days, which is awesome.
